## Final hypothesis

> In the pooled PCA over the 37 hundred-year slices (CE −4100…−500) of the 12 Z‑scored forms of capital, the **symbolic capital group — house size, daggers, and hatchets/swords — is characterized by positive, mid-range values on PC1 and a positive but strongly differentiated distribution across PC2.** All three load positively on PC1 (hatchet/sword 0.28, r = 0.55; dagger 0.23, r = 0.46; house size 0.17, r = 0.34), i.e. on the same "high‑capital" side as copper/gold (0.37), depots (0.33) and pottery decoration (0.39), and opposite to pottery form (−0.41) and axes/celts (−0.31), but with **smaller magnitudes than the metallic/commodity forms** — PC1 is a capital‑accumulation axis that climbs from EN (−1.9) and MN (−1.7) to an OBA peak (+3.0). On PC2 all three **also load positively** — house size 0.37 (r=0.52, the largest loading in the whole matrix), dagger 0.20 (r=0.29), hatchet/sword 0.14 (r=0.20) — placing them on the positive‑PC2 side opposite depots (−0.20), sickles (−0.33) and pottery decoration (−0.17). Their distribution across PC2 is however sharply unequal: **house size has the broadest spread** (projection range 1.29, IQR 0.41, sd 0.37), **dagger intermediate** (range 0.78, IQR 0.28), **hatchet/sword the narrowest** (range 0.48, IQR ≈ 0.01, tightly clustered at its baseline). The three occupy their positive‑PC2 territory at *different times* — house size at the EN→MN transition (~3500 BCE), daggers in the Late Neolithic (~1800 BCE), hatchets/swords in the Early Bronze Age (~1500 BCE) — so the group spans the positive half of PC2 as a staggered sequence across the middle periods rather than clustering on a single century.

## Supporting numbers (primary: 37‑row matrix, column‑standardized / correlation PCA)

**Variance:** PC1 = 32.4%, PC2 = 16.4% (cum 48.9% for two PCs).
**PC1/P C2 loadings & correlations (all 12 vars):**
- Symbolic: HatchetSword 0.28 (r .55) / PC2 0.14 (r .20) · Dagger 0.23 (r .46) / 0.20 (r .29) · HouseSize 0.17 (r .34) / **0.37 (r .52)**
- Others: CopperGold 0.37/.35 · Depot 0.33/−.20 · PotteryDecoration 0.39/−.17 · MonumentSize .24/.10 · MonumentCount .15/.47 · Amber −.29/.24 · AxesCelts −.31/.42 · Sickle −.13/−.33 · PotteryForm −.41/.20
**Per‑period slice‑score means (anchoring signs):** PC1: EN −1.86, MN −1.68, SG −1.38, LN +0.29, OBA +2.98, YBA +2.07. PC2: EN −0.47, MN +1.07, SG +0.72, LN −0.47, OBA +1.31, YBA −1.54.
**PC2 slice‑score extremes:** most negative −4100 (EN, −2.46), −1000/−900/−500 (YBA, ≈−2.1…−2.4); most positive −1300 OBA (+3.52), −1200 OBA (+2.52), −3200 MN (+2.00).
**Per‑variable PC2 projection (loading × standardized value), 37‑row:** HouseSize min −0.54@−4100, max +0.75@−3500; Dagger min −0.12@−4100, max +0.66@−1800; HatchetSword min −0.07@−4100, max +0.41@−1500.
**Per‑period density of |PC2 projection| (mean):** HouseSize EN .57, MN .28, SG .12, LN .31, OBA .22, YBA .24 · Dagger LN .32, OBA .20, else ≈.12 · HatchetSword **OBA .32**, else ≈.06.

## Sensitivity / assumptions flagged (as required)
- **Raw Z vs re‑standardized:** ordering of the symbolic group unchanged (raw‑Z PC1: HS .29, D .27, H .17; PC2: HouseSize .44 > Dagger .37 > HS .16). Raw Z per‑column stds were ≈1.0 for all except Sickle (0.55) and MonumentSize (0.66).
- **Including the 2 extra earliest capital.csv rows (BCE 4300/4200, outside the annual series window):** PC1 loadings of the group rise modestly (HouseSize .170→.225, Dagger .232→.266, HS .276→.299); PC2 loadings of Dagger and HatchetSword drop notably (0.201→0.074, 0.141→0.054) because the added rows are constant (zero‑variance) anchors at the negative‑PC2 end, while HouseSize stays dominant (0.365→0.327). **Qualitative conclusion is robust; the only quantity sensitive to these two out‑of‑window rows is the PC2 loading of Dagger/HatchetSword.** I used the 37‑row version (fully inside the annual series) as primary.
- Pollen/openness file not used — it is environmental context, not a form of capital, and the PCA fully determines the characterization without it.

**Workflow:** load raw capital Z‑values at the 37 century marks (CE −4100…−500, ignoring forward‑filled `_inter`), column‑standardize, SVD (numpy) → loadings/correlations/scores; project each variable onto PC2 for spread; per‑period means and extremes; sensitivity on raw‑Z covariance and on a 39‑row matrix including the 2 extra capital.csv rows. Executed artifact: `analysis_capital_pca.py` (output: `analysis_output.txt`).
